newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani president shows concern over comments.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani president shows concern over comments.

text.p: Pakistani President Farooq Leghari on Friday expressed grave concern over a series of what he called irresponsible statements in recent days and said the holders of public office should refrain from making them.

In a press note, a spokesman for the President said: "The President has noted with serious concern the series of unwarranted and irresponsible statements in recent days on matters of grave importance to the future stability of Pakistan."

The press note was issued after newspapers published a few comments of Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto at a meeting of the Federal Cabinet in Islamabad on Thursday, a week after the killing of her estranged brother Murtaza Bhutto in Karachi.
Newspapers quoted her as saying some people had started conspiracies against her government and wanted to illegally remove her government.
"We must remain responsible even in the face of adversity and personal loss. Matters of state should not be confused with nor subjected to personal issues," the press note said.
The president had expressed the hope that Bhutto would be able to handle this very difficult time with grace and calm, the press note said.
